caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rocking chair with a simple design. The chair's frame is made of brown wood, featuring two long curved runners at the bottom for rocking, four vertical legs, and horizontal supports connecting the legs. The backrest consists of three wide, horizontal slats that are slightly curved, attached to two vertical posts that extend upwards. The seat is composed of a woven material in a checkerboard pattern, combining black and red colors. The composition of the drawing places the chair diagonally, with a plain, light-colored background. The artist's name, "EMIL M. HAGEN," appears in small green letters near the lower right corner of the image.
title: Shaker Chair
